lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern posterior to the branchial region, with cluster diameter decreasing along the dorsal-to-ventral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a macro-grid structure where the blobs occupy the nodal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features running parallel to the main body axis, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with highlights on the superior edge and localized shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible in the ventral water column, following the trajectory of the shark's movement.
